profile.name: Kuma
profile.overview: Kuma (and Panda, often just referred to as bears) is an oddball character specializing in ranged poking and whiff punishment.
profile.playstyle: An oddball bear built on ranged poking and whiff punishment. Use his massive range and damage to punish every mistake, and go into Hunting Bear Stance (HBS) and his roll and sit stances for odd mix-ups. His huge, wonky hurtbox makes him take bigger combos, so avoid getting launched.
strengths: Hits Like a Bear: Massive range and damage which allows for easy, punishing sequences.
Disruptive: Possesses an i10 CH launch to keep opponents on their toes.
Bear Essentials: Wonky hurtbox makes him much harder to hit with lows and gives him surprising evasion with HBS and moves like WR1+2.
Circus Tricks: Can be tricky to play against with a plethora of strings.

Run. Unapologetically strong in Heat, dealing loads of chip damage with nearly uncontestable pressure; Heat Smash is i13 and has the range to punish many moves with pushback, and Kuma gains a more reliable launcher in Wind Bear Fist that high crushes, is neutral on block, and can be charged to reversal break and be plus on block. He can even hellsweep with H.db4,1 to potentially wall splat.
weaknesses: Massive: Wonky hurtbox makes him more susceptible to unique, higher damage combos for nearly the entire cast, as well as making evading moves harder.
One-trick Bear: Somewhat hinges on players not knowing Kuma's strings very well, requiring stronger fundamentals once defensive counterplay is established.
Physics-defying: Several launch punishable moves, including most of his lows and some of his key moves.
Slows: His strong lows are also slow, making them unusable on savvy opponents.
Not Panda: Block situations after his exclusive heat moves are worse than Panda's, and Heat Smash in particular has poor tracking.

stances.name: Hunting Bear Stance
stances.entry: D or 3+4 after moves like db+2 and u+1+2
stances.note: HBS.3+4 is a power crush and Heat Engager; HBS.df+2 and HBS.1+2 tornado; HBS.d+1+2 launches on counter hit.

stances.name: Roll
stances.note: ROL.1 is +4 on block and guard-breaks in Heat. Heat enhances the roll stance (Wavu).
